nodes.name: Pin Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values: your Pinterest board_id, the list of topics to rotate through, and the visual style used for every generated image.

assignments.name: topics
assignments.value: =["minimalist home office setup","cozy autumn recipe flat lay","boho bedroom decor","healthy meal prep ideas","indoor plant styling corner"]

assignments.name: image_style
assignments.value: high quality professional photography, warm natural lighting, styled flat lay, no text overlay, vertical portrait composition

nodes.name: Optimize Image
nodes.notes: Requires GraphicsMagick/ImageMagick on the n8n instance. Resizes/re-encodes the raw DALL-E output to Pinterest's recommended 2:3 portrait pin format and compresses it.

values.content: You are a Pinterest marketing copywriter. Given a topic, write SEO-optimized Pinterest pin content. Respond ONLY with valid JSON (no markdown fences) matching exactly this shape: {"title": string (<=100 chars), "description": string (<=450 chars, natural sentence including 3-5 relevant keywords), "alt_text": string (plain description of the image for accessibility), "hashtags": array of 5 lowercase hashtag words without the # symbol}

nodes.name: Create Pinterest Pin
nodes.notes: Requires a Generic OAuth2 API credential pointed at Pinterest's OAuth endpoints (see docs/pinterest-setup.md).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ board_id: $json.board_id, title: $json.title, description: $json.description, alt_text: $json.alt_text, media_source: { source_type: 'image_base64', content_type: $json.content_type, data: $json.image_base64 } }) }}
